title: 2.6 On the second floor
unit_title: Places, things and how we describe them
unit_outcome: Say where people go and how they get there, talk about the things people have, point things out and compare them, put things in order, and ask about favorites.
goal: Say which floor a place is on with second, third, fourth and fifth (The gym is on the second floor. / Where is the pool? It is on the fifth floor.).
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 2.6 Numbers 1-5: A1 counts one to five; A1+ 2.6 puts things in order with the ordinal numbers second, third, fourth and fifth, after the + before a noun (the second floor). A1 already says First, … for the first step of a routine. Each photo shows the elevator lobby of one floor of a building, with the floor number on the wall and the place behind a glass wall: the gym on 2, a store on 3, a restaurant on 4 and a pool on 5.
prerequisite: A1 2.6 one to five; A1 4.6 First, …; A1 4.15 the floor; A1 2.1 store, restaurant; A1+ 2.1 gym, pool; A1 Where is …?
speaking_outcome: Say second with a clear d, third with th and a long er, fourth with th at the end, fifth with f-th at the end. Do not require native-like speed.
